dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Oh my, it looks like Hertha has gone back to her duties, and Glenfidia is away somewhere too... Has our dear cutie taken complete charge of the drinks stand?

choices.text: That's right, yours truly is in charge!

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Wonderful. Now I can order without worrying about ending up with one of the Logistics Company "specials" — the type of drink that keeps you awake all night, leaving you no choice but to pass the time working...

choices.text: Working through the night... Shouldn't that be a thing of the past?

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: That's right! I'm just a carefree librarian now.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: If only there weren't so many people with overdue books, and I didn't have to go door-to-door to get them back... I would've dropped by to chat with you sooner — and try out your delightful creations, of course.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Let me think... Hmm, I don't really have a favorite drink. Just rustle me up something rejuvenating that'll lift my spirits.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: And if it could help me nod off to sleep later, that would be even better...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: (The drinks stand has a collection of classic recipes — let's start by choosing one of those...)

response.speaker: Player
response.text: (Since Lisa wants to feel rejuvenated, "Snow-Kissed Dawn" seems like a good choice...)

choices.text: I thought you weren't so rushed off your feet these days?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Finished! A new creation, custom-made for you...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: This should help you fall asleep quickly and guarantee you peaceful dreams. It's called a "Slumbering Rose."

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: From the colors to the choice of glass, everything's been carefully crafted. You've turned it into a completely different drink...

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Based purely on appearance, it's exactly my style! Time to see how it tastes...

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: It's like... savoring an exquisite dessert before taking a stroll along the shore of Cider Lake, with the gentle breeze caressing your skin, relaxed and at ease...

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: I no longer feel drained of energy, but neither am I overstimulated!

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: *yawn* I'm actually starting to feel a little sleepy... As a bedtime drink, this is pure perfection...

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: So good, in fact, that I feel like writing an article to extol the virtues of this "Slumbering Rose." I can use it as an opportunity to crown you the "New Maestro of Mixology."

choices.text: That might be taking things a little too far.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Speaking of lakeside strolls, why don't you join me next time there's a clear, warm day when the sun is bright but not too harsh?

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Any walk would be more relaxing with you to talk to along the way, cutie...

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Then, when we get back, you could fix me up another glass of Slumbering Rose!

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Haha, and I'll make just as sure to hold you to that.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: When the time comes, I won't accept any excuses!

choices.text: I'll make sure to set aside the time!
Your satisfaction is all the praise I need!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Here's a Snow-Kissed Dawn. Hope you like it!

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Pleasantly tart, sweet but not cloying, smooth on the palate, with a refreshing aftertaste.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: If anything, though, I seem to be feeling a little more energetic than I'd like...

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Perhaps you've unwittingly unraveled Glenfidia's secret and concocted an even more effective pick-me-up?

choices.text: Should I tinker with the ingredients?

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Don't worry, there's no rush! Hmm... Your eyes are aglow with curiosity, as though you have many more questions to ask...

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Let's chat for a while. Take your time... inspiration will come soon enough.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Which books have you collected today?

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: *sigh* Since you're asking, it's been a bit of an unusual day.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: There's a chef, fresh out of training in Fontaine, who's recently taken up a position at the Goth Grand Hotel. She borrowed our most valuable book, "The Mondstadt Millennial Compendium of Desserts."

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Apparently, she plans to use dessert-making techniques to improve the taste of various savory dishes. Something about reducing their greasiness...

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Indeed... and judging by the results, she rather overdid it with the caramel sauce. What should have been fragrant meat slices ended up tasting nauseatingly sweet.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Caramel sauce is such a fantastic ingredient, you know? It never fails to please when added to drinks. Sometimes, I even add a spoonful to my afternoon tea.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Improving food, I suppose, isn't always about being as creative as possible.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: By the way... Is that a notebook you brought with you?

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Oh, this? That was for another of today's little errands.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: A large contingent of the expedition team will be returning to Mondstadt soon. They've been away for such a long time, so there's a good chance many of their tastes have changed.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Jean asked me to visit some of their families to try and get a better understanding of what new ingredients might satisfy our knights' changing preferences.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Well, they've all devoted their blood, sweat, and time to protecting Mondstadt. They deserve some care and respect in return.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Based on what I gathered, the most requested ingredient was Cacahuatl from Natlan. It seems like our knights have developed a taste for cocoa.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: In their letters, many of them mentioned that they rely on cocoa to keep themselves energized. I've tried hot cocoa myself, and I must say, I find it just as effective as coffee when it comes to staying alert.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Been anywhere outside the city lately?

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Surely you're not suggesting I'd take this opportunity to sneak off on a little countryside wander? ...Hehe, you caught me!

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: My investigations into Mondstadt's lesser-known drinks took me to Dawn Winery, where I had a little chat with the Head Housemaid, Adelinde.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: On my way back, I ran into Ematol, out on patrol. She'd encountered some monsters she didn't know how to deal with, and in her desperation, asked for my help.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: I accompanied her on a detour to Wolvendom to teach some raving hounds a lesson... It's been a while since I've had such an invigorating workout!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: So, what kind of ingredients have you been into lately?

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: "Lately"? So careful with your wording, cutie...

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Is that because you think that I, too, might have changed since we last met... or simply because you can't remember?

choices.text: Well, you're so well-traveled and well-read...

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Not bad at all! A flawless answer.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Back in my student days, I might have been drawn to every new and exciting ingredient I read about, constantly expanding my horizons and stepping out of my comfort zone. But now, I've grown accustomed to a life of comfort and routine.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: To paraphrase a certain Liyue legal expert, my life is fast approaching a state of "living out one's golden years in peace and comfort." I'm no longer so easily moved by adventure and excitement.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: I'm sure you remember — a few years ago, when we were adventuring together, you found me that sweet-tasting alchemical ingredient...

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Well, my tastes haven't changed a bit since then.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Alright, I think I know what fits the bill.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Let me rustle you up a new, improved version!

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: As expected, cutie, your brilliant mind has grown even sharper. Just a few gentle hints were all you needed to light that special spark of inspiration!

choices.text: Surely it's normal for your tastes to change from time to time...
That sure is a novel approach.
How about I adjust the recipe and mix you a new one?
